PoliticaCookies.title: Cookies Policy
PoliticaCookies.section_1_text: A cookie is a file that is downloaded to your computer when you access certain web pages. Cookies allow a web page, among other things, to store and retrieve information about the browsing habits of a user or their equipment and, depending on the information they contain and the way they use their equipment, they can be used to recognize the user.
PoliticaCookies.section_2_title: 2. What types of cookies does this website use?
PoliticaCookies.section_2_text: This website is built mainly with modern technologies that minimize the use of cookies. We mainly use:
PoliticaCookies.section_2_li_1: Technical cookies: These are those that allow the user to navigate through a web page, platform or application and the use of the different options or services that exist in it.
PoliticaCookies.section_2_li_2: Analysis cookies: These are those that, well treated by us or by third parties, allow us to quantify the number of users and thus perform the measurement and statistical analysis of the use made by users of the service offered.
PoliticaCookies.section_3_text: You can allow, block or delete the cookies installed on your computer by configuring the browser options installed on your computer. Check your browser's instructions and manuals for more information.

quorum.title: quorum
quorum.description: Mobile application designed to modernize community governance and facilitate asynchronous decision-making. Built with React Native and Supabase, it integrates a complete voting system, real-time user management, and monetization via RevenueCat, delivering a seamless and scalable experience. Project developed as a participation entry for the Shipathon 2026.

inazuma-endavant.title: Inazuma Endavant
inazuma-endavant.description: Comprehensive ecosystem that gamifies and manages activities across multiple platforms. It features a monorepo housing a robust backend and two PWA frontends, a dedicated mobile app for offline NFC card reading for physical interactions, Python scripts for data processing, and a technical documentation website that covers the entire architecture.

hydraflow.title: Hydraflow
hydraflow.description: Full-stack mobile application focused on tracking and monitoring daily water consumption. Designed with a robust backend architecture using Nest.js and PostgreSQL, combined with an agile React Native frontend, ensuring optimal performance and efficient user data management. Currently in beta phase.

jesucristo-superstar.title: Jesucristo Superstar
jesucristo-superstar.description: Interactive web application designed to present the scenes, songs, and biblical readings of the 2026 "Hilo Conductor" campaign for the Juniors M.D. Endavant center.

schoolyard-wheel.title: Schoolyard Wheel
schoolyard-wheel.description: Automated Python script for the dynamic and equitable assignment of schoolyard zones. It generates optimized monthly layouts, facilitating the efficient organization of the academic year and saving hours of manual planning.

sociograma-ia.title: WeavyAI
sociograma-ia.description: System designed as a monorepo that facilitates the creation, management and analysis of sociograms, allowing the evaluation of social dynamics within a group through forms and graph visualizations. Project developed for the TechForEquality 2026 hackathon by ACM UPV.

sorteo-medieval.title: Medieval Raffle
sorteo-medieval.description: Website for the raffle of the II Solidarity Medieval Dinner for the benefit of the Novaterra association.
